shortDescription: Information module for Network Device Images Count

options.name: dnac_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: dnac_password
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center password to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_username
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center username to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: dnac_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco DNA Center to use.

options.name: managementAddress
options.description: ManagementAddress query parameter. IP address or DNS name used to access and manage network devices.

options.name: networkDeviceImageStatus
options.description: NetworkDeviceImageStatus query parameter. Network device image status with respect to golden images. Available values OUTDATED, UP_TO_DATE, UNKNOWN, CONFLICTED, UNSUPPORTED.

options.name: networkDeviceUpdateStatus
options.description: NetworkDeviceUpdateStatus query parameter. Network device current update status with respect to golden images. Available values DISTRIBUTION_PENDING, DISTRIBUTION_IN_PROGRESS, DISTRIBUTION_FAILED, ACTIVATION_PENDING, ACTIVATION_IN_PROGRESS, ACTIVATION_FAILED, DEVICE_UP_TO_DATE,UNKNOWN.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
